text:
paul-rep: Need a hosted demo key for Redwood POC with Solstice Health next Mon. Requirements: chat+embeddings, IP allowlist (3 IPs), short TTL, billing tag 'poc/solstice', and a one-page rotate/revoke playbook for their security review.

rita-eng: We can issue ephemeral hosted keys scoped to chat+embed. Security prefers 24h TTL for public-hosted creds. I'll create primary + standby and drop into 1Password. Send IPs and contact.

paul-rep: IPs: 203.0.113.45, 203.0.113.46, 203.0.113.47. Contact: demos@solstice.example.com. Customer likes 48h but will accept 24h.

zoe-sec: For questionnaire: include Console Activity export showing create + revoke events, creator identity, allowlist, and metadata. Note: hosted keys are managed in our control plane; per-tenant KMS is only on Private/Dedicated enterprise option. Mark as blocker if they insist.

rita-eng: API call I'll use (admin token redacted):
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{"name":"poc-solstice-demo","scopes":["chat","embeddings"],"expires_in":86400,"rate_limit":12,"allowlist_ips":["203.0.113.45","203.0.113.46","203.0.113.47"],"metadata":{"billing_tag":"poc/solstice","contact":"demos@solstice.example.com"}}'

ops-bot: key created: hosted_key_poc_solstice_2024  created by rita-eng  expires in 24h  scopes: chat, embeddings  rate_limit:12 req/s

paul-rep: Can we avoid exposing plaintext key in control plane? Customer asks about KMS wrapping.

zoe-sec: Hosted keys are not KMS-wrapped per customer. Offer Private trial or Dedicated with enterprise keying for KMS/HSM. Flag in questionnaire.

rita-eng: Rotation/revoke playbook: 1) create key with 24h TTL, 2) store primary+standby in 1Password, 3) revoke immediately if compromise suspected (see curl example), 4) post-demo revoke and export Activity CSV. Revoke example:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/hosted_key_poc_solstice_2024/revoke \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'

ops-bot: key revoked: hosted_key_poc_solstice_2024  revoked by rita-eng  revocation_time: 2050012600

paul-rep: Thanks — I uploaded the audit CSV and rotation playbook to the deal folder and briefed the customer.
